data.review_body:
Every time you open the Temu app, it displays flashy graphics claiming you’ve received money back that you can use to buy whatever you want within minutes. In my experience, those offers are misleading. As soon as you click on an item to check the offer and see the final price, the app charges your PayPal account for the full amount instead of applying the advertised credit. This has happened to me multiple times, forcing me to waste time canceling orders and contacting PayPal for refunds. I found the experience very deceptive and frustrating.
Look at their response in the bottom. They just threw few words like nothing happened. The reality they must have done this with thousands may be millions times. There are some old people who don’t have the patience to get their money back and they found their credit cards charged for a product they did not ment to buy. You guys should be band here in the USA.

data.review_body:
I used to enjoy shopping with Temu, but this experience has completely changed my opinion of the company.

My package was delayed, and after my delivery address was corrected, I was assured that my order would be delivered. Instead, I spent days trying to get answers from GOFO Carrier and was repeatedly ignored. There were no meaningful updates, no accountability, and no way to get a straight answer about where my package was.

When I contacted Temu, I received polite but generic responses saying they had “escalated” the issue. An apology without a solution is not customer service. The companies Temu chooses to deliver its orders represent the Temu brand, and GOFO’s complete lack of communication reflects very poorly on the company.

Customers shouldn’t have to chase a carrier for days just to get basic information about an order. After this experience, I no longer trust Temu with my purchases and will be taking my business elsewhere. 

Response to Temu’s Response: Thank you for your response, but this is now the third time I have been told my issue has been
"escalated," and absolutely nothing has changed.
I have received the same generic response repeatedly while my actual problem has gone unresolved.
Simply stating that the matter has been escalated is not a resolution. My package was mishandled, I was ignored for days, and despite multiple assurances that someone would follow up, no one has taken meaningful action.
This experience has shown a serious lack of accountability from both Temu and the carrier handling my order. Customers deserve more than automated apologies and repeated promises that lead nowhere.
Unless this issue is actually resolved instead of being "escalated" yet again, my review will remain as an accurate reflection of my experience. I will also continue sharing my experience on other review platforms so that other customers are aware of how this situation was handled.
I expect action—not another copy-and-paste response.
